Name: AT x CP - Molamole's Wallpaper and Flooring textures 2
Author: MolaMole
Description:
Here more Vanilla[b] Wallpaper & Flooring[/b] textures! following my first mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27122]AT x CP - Molamole's Wallpaper and Flooring textures[/url]
[i]Mole is kinda experimenting by this point, sometimes I find interesting pattern and think if it could be traslated to pixel art. Sometimes they do, sometimes they don't.[/i]

There Are...:
[list]
[*][b][CP] Molamole's Wallpaper & Flooring Textures 2[/b] (+500 wallpaper and +200 flooring)[/*]
[*][b][b][AT] Molamole's Wallpaper & Flooring Textures 2[/b][/b] (+500 wallpaper and +200 flooring)[/*]
[*][b][b][b][b][AT] Molamole's Wallpaper & Flooring Textures 2 Desaturated[/b][/b][/b][/b] (+500 wallpaper and +200 flooring)[/*]
[/list]

[b][s][size=3][ Known issues][/size][/s][/b]
None for now (If you find one pls let me know!)
-
If you don't want the [i]Night version[/i] -The crystal/windows wallpaper getting dark at night or rainy days- you can delete the file "[b][CP] Molamole's Wallpaper 2- Night[/b]", from the main folder.

[center][size=4][b]IMPORTANT: [/b][b]
You need to have the [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative texture[/url]﻿] / Mod -for the [AT] ver.-
[[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]] and [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]] / Mods -for the [CP] ver.-
to choose the texture[/b][/size].[size=2][b]-
Mole only upload Mods on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/][/url][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/]Nexus[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]CurseForge[/url]﻿﻿![/size],
If you find them in other places, were submit without my knowledge
and I can't guarantee the safety of the file. 
Be careful out there![/b][/size]
